No context file written: Epic 5 has open questions (Epic 6 has none).
Epic 5
- Story 5.1: When `xarabot join` finds an existing App whose permissions go beyond the manifest (e.g. `administration`, `workflows`, or any extra), what does it do? Readings: (a) ignore extras and check only missing ones, so join passes an App with admin rights; (b) stop and name each permission to remove, as it does for missing ones; (c) stop only for forbidden rights (administration, workflows, bypass) and warn on other extras.
- Story 5.2: Does join's verification also check that the installation has accepted the App's current permissions (an org owner must approve a permission added later)? Readings: (a) no, it checks only the App's settings, and a lane later hits 403 or the lane-start check; (b) yes, it compares the installation's granted permissions with the manifest and stops, naming the pending acceptance and who must approve it.
